full_prompt_en: A square, color-shifted documentary photograph shows a single-file line of helmeted figures moving away through tall, intensely pink grass toward a rounded mountain. The foreground path begins near the lower center and winds into the middle-left distance, only partly visible beneath the dense vegetation. On the lower right, the nearest figure is seen from behind wearing a muted gray-green uniform and a rounded helmet. Straps cross the back, and a long dark object hangs diagonally at the side. Another figure in similar clothing walks ahead near the center, one arm swinging away from the body; more helmeted figures reduce to small dark shapes along the path. Their number is difficult to fix because the line disappears into foliage. Magenta and crimson grasses rise to their waists and shoulders, forming nearly continuous bands across the lower half. In the middle ground, flattened umbrella-shaped trees stand against the slope, their crowns rendered in deep red-purple and their dark branching trunks visible beneath. The mountain fills most of the upper half, its rounded summit near the upper center and its ridges striped with hot pink, mauve, and dark gray vegetation. A narrow strip of pale blue-gray sky runs along the top and brightens slightly to the left. The colors appear deliberately shifted as in infrared photography: foliage becomes saturated pink and red while uniforms remain subdued green-gray. Despite the unusual palette, the scene retains natural spatial depth, with crisp grasses in the foreground, receding figures, and soft distant mountain contours. Diffuse daylight comes through the overcast sky, providing even illumination without hard cast shadows. Slightly brighter pale tones on the ridge and helmets separate them from the surrounding pink. The overall composition is a quiet procession into an uncanny landscape, balancing small gray-green silhouettes against a vast mass of crimson vegetation and cloud-softened mountains.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、经过色彩转换的纪实摄影呈现一列戴钢盔的人沿单行队伍远离镜头，穿过高而鲜艳的粉色草地走向圆润山峰。前景小路从下方中央开始，向中左侧远处蜿蜒，部分被浓密植被遮住。右下方最近的人背对镜头，穿灰绿色制服，戴圆顶钢盔。带子交叉经过背部，一件长而深的物件斜挂在身侧。前方中央另一位穿相似服装的人正往前走，一只手臂向身侧摆开；更多戴钢盔者沿小路缩成深色小形体。队伍没入植物，人数难以确定。品红与深绯红草丛高至腰和肩，在下半幅形成近乎连续的色带。中景，扁平伞状树立在山坡前，树冠呈深红紫色，下面可见深色分枝。山体占据上半部大部分区域，圆顶靠近上方中央，山脊由亮粉、灰紫和深灰色植物条纹覆盖。顶部一道狭窄蓝灰色天空向左略微变亮。色彩显然像红外摄影一样被刻意转换：植物变成饱和粉红与红色，制服仍维持低调灰绿。尽管色域奇异，场景仍有自然纵深，前景草清晰，人物逐渐退远，山体远处轮廓柔和。漫散日光穿过阴天，提供均匀照明，没有硬投影。山脊和钢盔上略浅的色调让它们与粉色周围分开。整体构图是一队人安静地进入陌生地貌，以小块灰绿剪影平衡大片绯红植物和被云光柔化的山地。
style_prompt_en: The color-shifted photography gives organic surfaces an intense magenta-to-crimson range while retaining selected neutral or muted green-gray elements. Realistic texture and spatial perspective remain intact beneath the unnatural chromatic mapping. Dense near vegetation forms a vivid continuous field; darker silhouettes and receding linear gaps guide the eye through it. Distant forms soften into mauve and slate bands, with a pale overcast sky keeping contrast controlled. Diffuse daylight avoids sharp theatrical shadows, so the color transformation rather than dramatic lighting carries the strangeness. Small dark details remain legible against broad saturated areas. The overall effect is documentary yet uncanny, with tactile realism and extreme color operating at the same time.
style_prompt_zh: 这种色彩转换摄影让有机表面呈现强烈的品红到绯红色域，同时保留部分中性或低调灰绿色元素。不自然的色彩映射下，真实肌理与空间透视仍完整保留。密集近处植物组成连续鲜艳色域，较暗剪影和逐渐退远的线状空隙引导视线穿过其间。远处形体柔化为灰紫和石板灰色带，浅色阴天控制对比。漫散日光避免锐利戏剧性阴影，因此陌生感主要来自色彩转换。小面积深色细节在宽阔饱和区域前仍然可辨。整体效果既有纪实感又显诡异，让可触的真实感与极端色彩同时存在。
theme_en: A line of helmeted figures walking through vivid infrared-pink grass toward a mountain
theme_zh: 头戴钢盔的人群列队穿过鲜艳红外粉草地走向山峰
name: Richard Mosse
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
